pattern: までだ / までのことだ
aliases: made da / made no koto da
purpose: Present an action as a simple fallback or explain a limited intention.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
V dictionary / た + までだ / までのことだ
If there is no bus, I will simply walk.
I only called because I was worried.
If it fails, I will just do it again.
formation: V dictionary / た + までだ / までのことだ
restrictions: Dictionary form often expresses resolve; past form limits an explanation.
mistake: It can sound dismissive when used to defend an action.
